subject: Operations
title: Fair Trade and Certifications
description: One-minute skill: Fair Trade and Certifications.

hook.text: A farmer in Guatemala earns $1 for coffee beans that sell for $5 at a café. Fair trade tries to fix that gap.

buildup.text: Certifications like Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, and B Corp signal ethical and sustainable practices.

discovery.text: Fair trade guarantees minimum prices, safe conditions, and community investment for producers in developing nations.

twist.text: Certifications cost money. Small producers may meet standards but can't afford the audit. The system is imperfect.

climax.text: Consumer willingness to pay more for certified goods is growing—ethics are becoming a market differentiator.

punchline.text: A label can change a farmer's life—if the system works.

quiz.question: What does Fair Trade guarantee producers?
